title: Breaking down information silos
summary: Helping communities discover each other's activities, and making information available before opportunities have passed.

sources.description: Ken Granderson's kickoff handoff: the My Bed-Stuy community calendar 'illustrates a particularly important philosophy'.

editorNotes: EXAMPLE DRAFT created to exercise the workflow. The summary paraphrases one sentence of the handoff and is not final language about Ken's beliefs. No philosophy taxonomy is implied; that waits for the review of the GrpIcon help file and Duty and Opportunity.
